tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List CityAlert focus regions (key, label, center, zoom, bbox). Use region keys with get_incidents.

tools.name: get_incidents
tools.description: Merged live incidents from all feeds plus manual reports. Filter by region key, category, group, severity, source, or bbox. Results come from a shared ~15-minute snapshot; real-time refresh requires an API key with that entitlement (details: cityalert.live/developers).

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Historical aggregates: VPD crime by year/month/type (6y), USGS M4+ quakes per region (10y), GDACS global events (3y), report and live snapshot stats. Use for questions about patterns over time — crime trends, quake frequency, disaster cadence. For what's happening right now, use get_incidents.

tools.name: get_crime_year
tools.description: Full-year VPD crime data: totals and ranked neighbourhood stats. Vancouver only, 2003-present.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Per-region safety news items, or news for an arbitrary place name.

tools.name: submit_report
tools.description: File a manual geolocated incident report (same as POST /api/reports). Reports are moderated before they appear publicly. Errors: 'report submission disabled' if the caller is blocked; 'rate limited' past 20 reports/hour via MCP.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Read a saved dashboard by id (shareable, read-only).

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create a shareable dashboard. Returns {id, token} — the token grants write access via PUT /api/dashboards, so save it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_incidents · Private data: get_incidents, submit_report, create_dashboard · Public sink: submit_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_incidents · Private data: get_incidents, submit_report, create_dashboard · Public sink: submit_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_incidents" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Merged live incidents from all feeds plus manual reports. Filter by region key, category, group, severity, source, or bbox. Anonymous and free-key calls get a shared ~1-minute snapshot; a pro/business x-api-key header (from cityalert.live/account) unlocks real-time refresh and higher limits." → after: "Merged live incidents from all feeds plus manual reports. Filter by region key, category, group, severity, source, or bbox. Results come from a shared ~15-minute snapshot; real-time refresh requires an API key with that entitlement (details: cityalert.live/developers)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
